note: CANDIDATE OFFICIAL (the user, 2 Nov): the staging pool - aeroplanes designed and built, not validated. The garage offers them under 'candidate official' (the load rack and the new-aeroplane cards), in the sandbox and a career, from these files (not the browser's storage). No certificate, not in the career catalogue, the contracts or the story. The file names are the user's / the builders' own and stay as they are. OFFERED here = only what the user named (2 Nov); review/ holds the planes found in the repo, not offered and not in this index, until the user promotes one (review/REVIEW.md). One plane, one file: an older version of a plane that just evolved is not kept, a real configuration change (floats, a STOL kit) is. Add one: node tools/candidates_add.js <a build or an 'export all' file> [--review].
